method: Built-in image_gen; new complete illustration using existing art/layout only as references. No original-image crop/paste/upscale used in final background.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: NEW high-resolution textless background artwork for a Chinese ancient Egypt educational game's landscape mobile mission page.
Reference image 1 is ONLY a visual style/character reference. Reference image 2 is ONLY the exact layout reference. Do not crop, enlarge, sharpen, or paste the old image; freshly repaint the scene, papyrus, icons and gold edges with newly resolved fine illustration detail.
Produce one wide 2560x1056 pixel landscape illustration (aspect about 2.42:1), filling the entire canvas. Match the existing warm polished illustrated style, turquoise/teal enamel, luminous gold and creamy papyrus, temple setting and friendly adult male Egyptian embalmer in ivory robes with a blue/gold collar. Crisp clean anti-aliased edges; no halos, cut-and-paste rectangles, torn seams or low-resolution crops.
Composition coordinates as percentages of entire image: LEFT 0–30% is a complete purpose-composed character/temple panel showing the same friendly shaved-head adult embalmer waist up at a worktable, hands, linen rolls and turquoise/gold jar; clear headroom, naturally framed edges, no severed fingers. His gaze faces the right panel. RIGHT 30–99% is one large blank ivory papyrus panel with thin ornate gold frame and small teal/gold lotus corners, from y=2% to98%. This preserves the reference layout. Leave ample empty parchment at x34–95%, y7–30% and y58–77% for live Chinese copy (do not paint that copy).
Five evenly spaced identical circular teal and gold medallions, centers at x43%,53.7%,64.3%,75%,85.7%, y44%, each diameter 9% of canvas width (about22% of canvas height). Each has ONE clean ivory educational pictogram, with some space beneath for a live label: from left to right a human head in profile, a simple torso silhouette, a water droplet, a folded linen roll, an Egyptian tomb entrance. No numbers or letters in the medallions. Their edges are truly integrated into the parchment, no square backgrounds.
At bottom two empty rounded teal enamel gold rim buttons integrated in the paper: left bounds x33–54%, y83–96%; right bounds x56–96%, y83–96%. Small lotus details at ends, clean unobstructed center to place live text. No text anywhere, no Chinese, no Latin, no digits, no watermark, no extra UI header. Keep all vital illustrations inside their assigned panels and preserve the exact existing layout. Render at high resolution, with finely painted cloth, gold, ceramics and parchment; not photorealism, not a flat vector simplification.
